result.reason: The operative language reaches at least the fallback and substantially reaches the preferred position: it covers Affiliates and contractors, permits transfer to an M&A successor, prevents termination solely because of that transaction, and limits Licensor termination to an uncured material breach. The changes are confined to the playbook issues and preserve the Field of Use and payment limitations. Drafting quality is reduced because the conflicting employee-only, immediate-termination, change-of-control, and anti-assignment provisions remain in place and are addressed only through a broad notwithstanding clause, creating avoidable interpretive tension. It also does not expressly provide that any paid-up licence is perpetual and irrevocable, so it does not fully implement that element of the preferred position.
